description: A warm muted brown knee-length wool tunic over an undyed ivory long-sleeved linen shirt, narrow dark-blue tablet-woven trim along the cuffs and split neckline, a practical dark leather belt with a simple bronze buckle, charcoal wool trousers, restrained grey-brown leg wraps and worn but well-kept brown leather shoes. Clean everyday early medieval Scandinavian landowner dress with modest workmanship; no fur war gear, armor, weapons, head covering or heraldic emblems.
